Switching to ILIKE substring or direct code-prefix lookup recovered candidates in every case.

Implication for the classifier: FTS alone is insufficient as a recall layer. Continue relying on embedding-based semantic search plus chapter-rule routing; FTS is best used as a supplementary recall signal, not the primary one.
